items.text: Two years into #COVID19, shortages of effective treatments like monoclonal antibodies are unacceptable. On the House floor, I urged @POTUS to make this life-saving treatment more readily-available in #WI06 and nationwide. https://t.co/808oW9goJj

Monoclonal antibodies have been a resounding success in treating #COVID19. Notably, President Trump used them when he contracted the virus. The fact that this treatment isn’t widely available is yet another shortcoming of @POTUS during his first year in office. @RepublicanStudy https://t.co/lDRqH4NkuP
This week, I had a productive meeting with #WI06 members of @EveryLifeOrg about supporting all rare disease patients in #WI06 and nationwide. https://t.co/VRxmHTMSJ1

During a @GOPoversight hearing, I discussed Pharmacy Benefit Managers’ ability to manipulate prescription drug markets for more profit. Last year, I introduced legislation to fix this problem by giving more power to patients. https://t.co/vP7aGwqtmT
It was great to meet with #WI members of the Alliance for Childhood Cancer to discuss initiatives for a more patient-centered approach to childhood cancer treatment. https://t.co/8aPeZW7Iyz

It was a pleasure visiting Lakeshore Community Health Care in #Manitowoc to speak with the caregivers and residents of the community about how I am working to fix our health care system and return power to patients. #WI06 https://t.co/rSQuTnbWLJ
Thank you to #WI members of @Pathologists for meeting with me and answering my questions regarding vitamin D deficiencies and severe #COVID19 symptoms. https://t.co/g7UKiDhY4A
Today, I met with @patientcitizen to discuss issues facing dialysis patients and ways we can improve the quality of life for those with chronic kidney disease. https://t.co/rMb9PmIEMO
Thank you to #WI members of the @alzassociation for coming to meet with me in #DC. I’m ready to help Alzheimer’s patients fight this devastating disease. https://t.co/gkPlyghY1J

I met with @alsassociation yesterday about getting ALS patients timely access to their disability benefits so they don't have to wait months as they battle this devastating disease. https://t.co/gofj5sUGjL

Today, we recognize and give thanks to pharmacists for all they do for patients on a daily basis, dedicating their time to the health and well-being of communities in #WI and across the country. Happy #NationalPharmacistDay! https://t.co/DqKrcYvpK8
This week, I sat down with #WI members of @LeadingAge to discuss patient-centered healthcare and supporting our elderly community. https://t.co/A06fQJq8zT

I am proud to cosponsor @repjenkiggans's bipartisan legislation to remove unnecessary government red tape that hinders the ability of nurses to work to the best of their ability.

By passing this bill, we can lower costs and improve the quality of healthcare for patients.

This May, join me in celebrating Older Americans Month.

In Washington, I am fighting for our elderly neighbors by remaining steadfast in my support and protection of Medicare and Social Security.

Happy #OlderAmericansMonth!
Thank you to Oasis Healthcare in #Grafton for inviting me into your facility for a detailed look into your care to help the health and well-being of #WI06 residents. https://t.co/8AntxYVwT9

The Wisconsin Academy of Nutrition and Dietetics is an organization of #WI nutrition professionals that are dedicating to improving the health of Wisconsinites. Thanks for coming to my office in #FDL! #WI06 https://t.co/rZE5FjirSd

It was a pleasure visiting Rogers Behavioral Health and meeting with the wonderful team in their #Sheboygan location. I am grateful for all the work you do to support patients in #WI06! https://t.co/31WQSsAnNk

Americans diagnosed w/ cancer deserve their preferred method of chemotherapy treatment at the most affordable cost, yet oral medications result in over-the-top copayments.

The Cancer Drug Parity Act will require health insurers provide equal coverage for oral and IV treatments.
It was a pleasure meeting with the #WI Hospice and Palliative Care Association to discuss how I can best serve Wisconsin’s hospice professionals and patients in Washington. https://t.co/Z7x84mskBV

Honored to receive The Guardian of Seniors' Rights Award from 60 Plus Association! I was presented this award by Jim Martin and Saul Anuzis. I am committed to advocating for seniors' rights, including Social Security & Medicare. https://t.co/AT0EBQZAwF
I had a meeting on Monday with the School Nutrition Association of Wisconsin to discuss the group's key priorities and strategies for providing healthier school meals. https://t.co/yVgUYc41tb

Today, I had a meeting with members from the American Dental Association. Our discussions revolved around various legislative matters, notably the Action for Dental Health Act, which I wholeheartedly supported with a "yes" vote. Excitingly, it's now headed to the Senate! https://t.co/SK8Wyy8Ipj
This week, I had a meeting with the Wisconsin Hospital Association in D.C. to discuss how Congress can help improve our health care systems and put patients first. https://t.co/pZcfReLTEA

I met with Michael Stanley, Oshkosh Fire Chief in D.C. today.  We discussed issues impacting the provision of fire protection and emergency medical services that the constituents in WI-06 face. https://t.co/tvci3rgULA

Had a great night at Columbus Prairie Ridge Toasts & Tastes  on April 26th. The proceeds from this year’s event goes to Fetal Non-Stress Test Equipment for the Prairie Ridge Health Clinics in Beaver Dam and Sun Prairie! https://t.co/WLy86umPUv
